scope: Generic read-only query-focus review; no tuning or new evaluation on the original ten queries.
confirmed_findings: applySubjectDemotion treats any first-person pronoun as user focus, independently of its grammatical role.
QueryIntent has retrieval mode, temporal flags and untyped entities, but no ownership or narrator/target roles.
SearchRequest.options supplies candidate strings, not subject scope.
Typed relation expansion repeats the first-person-to-user assumption. Optional semantic reranking happens after subject demotion and candidate truncation, and is disabled in the recorded runs.

single_candidate_design.name: query focus independent of retrieval mode
single_candidate_design.criterion: Determine whose requested property/state is sought. Reporting clauses identify narrator/source; possessive relations must preserve which noun they modify.

effects.other_people: Only when independently established, cancel the third-party penalty for actual facts; preserve raw/event handling.
effects.unknown: Keep baseline. Do not expand scope.

single_candidate_design.producer_status: No reliable existing structured producer found; defer production implementation rather than stack query-keyword exemptions.

generic_contrast_fixtures.query: list my plans with my friends
list the food preferences I told you about for my friends

ambiguous_must_not_expand: conflicting ownership clauses or requests only inside quoted text
local_check: Three novel minimal pairs run through frozen intent pure function: same mode/entities/self flags and same third-party multiplier despite opposite ownership. This proves missing representation, not semantic classifier accuracy.
decision: Defer prior broad mode exemption. No new production rule or model request.
